
### Pre-requisite:

<br>

::: {style="padding: 1em 1em 1em 1em;  margin-bottom: 5px;  border: 1px solid #64a1ce;  border-radius: 5px;  background:#f5f5f5 5px center/3em no-repeat;"}
![](images/info.png){width="4%"} **Usage of the term "parameter"**

This guide uses the term **"parameter"** to represent clinical analysis parameters and values such as
laboratory values, safety values, etc., as used in the clinical dataset context. This can be confused
with the word "parameter" used in a programming context - "parameters of a function". Therefore, to avoid
ambiguity in this guide:

-   **Parameter** is used exclusively in the clinical dataset context.
-   **Argument** is used to represent the parameter of a function in the programming context.
:::
